newsitem.title: CHINA: HSBC Asia insurance arm names Hubbard CEO.
newsitem.headline: HSBC Asia insurance arm names Hubbard CEO.

text.p: HSBC Insurance, a unit of HSBC Holdings Plc, said on Thursday it had appointed Robert Hubbard as chief executive of its Asia-Pacific holding company.
Hubbard, formerly chief executive of HSBC Life Holdings Ltd, replaced Simon Brett, who is being named managing director of the group's recent acquisition in Brazil, HSBC Bamerindus Seguros.
HSBC Insurance comprises the insurance underwriting subsidiaries of the HSBC Group.
In the Asia-Pacific region, the company consists of six operating companies based in Hong Kong, Macau and Singapore providing life, medical and general insurance. It has an assets of HK$21 billion.
